about.titleA: We teach from inside the profession,
about.lede: Aura Academy was founded by Amira Bechini, CEO of Amira Beauty Suite and a permanent makeup artist with more than eight years in the industry. Every technique taught here is one she performs on real clients, in her own institute, every day.
about.portrait: Amira Bechini in her beauty institute

story.title: From the treatment room to the classroom
story.role: Founder of Aura Academy · CEO of Amira Beauty Suite
story.imageAlt: Amira Bechini at work during a course
story.p1: My name is Amira Bechini. I run Amira Beauty Suite, a beauty institute specialised in advanced aesthetic treatments, and I founded Aura Academy to teach what I practise: permanent makeup and lash and brow lamination.
story.p2: In more than eight years in the beauty industry I have trained over 150 students, and along the way I built a method of my own, one that holds technical excellence, hands-on practice and entrepreneurial vision together. My passion for this work began with a simple desire: to help people feel confident, and to create real career opportunities for women who want to turn that passion into a profession.
story.p3: I have never stopped studying, international masterclasses, the latest PMU techniques, continuous investment in my own education. Working every day inside my institute taught me the rest: not only the technical side of the profession, but the real needs of clients and of the beauty market.
story.p4: That is why Aura Academy exists. It is the school I wanted when I started: personalised guidance, practical education, continuous support, and the confidence to build a career that lasts. Today we train students throughout Italy.

different.title: Built on the work, not on the theory
different.sub: Three deliberate choices sit behind every course we run.

experience.title: Real industry experience
experience.body: Aura Academy grew out of daily practice inside a working beauty institute. What you learn here has already been tested on real clients.

small.title: Small classes, by design
small.body: Places are intentionally limited. A small group is what makes individual attention and personalised coaching possible, rather than something we promise and cannot give.

support.title: Before, during and after
support.body: Every student is supported throughout: continuous mentoring, practical feedback, correction of their work, and professional guidance once the course has ended.

beyond.title: A technique alone is not a career.
beyond.sub: A successful PMU artist has to master far more than the treatment itself. Alongside the technical training, we teach the eight things that turn a skill into a business.

mission.quote: The certificate is not the point. The career is.
mission.body: At Aura Academy we don't simply teach beauty treatments. We educate future professionals, combining technical excellence, practical experience, an entrepreneurial mindset and continuous support, so that every student leaves confident and genuinely prepared for today's beauty industry.

vision.title: An international reference for PMU education
vision.body: We are building Aura Academy into an international point of reference for professional education in permanent makeup and beauty lamination, growing across Italy and internationally through a network of certified trainers and a community of professionals who hold the same standards.
vision.closing: Our goal is modern, practical, market-oriented education, and more women able to build an independent and successful future.

blurbs.microblading: Hair by hair strokes drawn with a manual blade, following the natural growth of the brow.
blurbs.powder-brows: A soft shaded brow built with the machine, from a light veil to a defined finish.
blurbs.lip-blush: Colour worked into the lip to correct the tone and redefine the border.
blurbs.eyeliner-pmu: A line set at the base of the lashes, from a discreet enhancement to a defined eye.
blurbs.lash-lamination: A lifting treatment that opens the eye by reshaping the natural lash.
blurbs.brow-lamination: The brow hair restructured and set in the direction that suits the face.

faq.title: Before you begin.
faq.more: Can't find your answer? Write to us and we'll reply.

courses.a: Microblading, Powder Brows, Lip Blush, PMU Eyeliner, Lash Lamination and Brow Lamination, at base and advanced level.

duration.a: Duration varies by the course chosen. We confirm it along with your quote.

price.q: How much does a course cost?
price.a: Every course is quoted individually, and the details are shared privately rather than published. Write to us or message Amira and you will receive the full information for the course you are interested in, including the professional kit option.

includes.a: Theory, hands-on practice, a live model where scheduled, and post-course support.

kit.a: The kit is available on request. Where it is included, the course price reflects it.

students.q: How many students are on a course?
students.a: Three to four. Places are limited by design.

certificate.a: Yes, at the end of the course.

language.q: What language are the courses taught in?

booking.q: How do I book and how do I pay?
booking.a: Book on WhatsApp or through the contact form on this site. Your place is confirmed with a deposit, agreed between us; payment is by bank transfer, card or PagoDIL.

location.a: Across Italy. Write to us and we will send you the details for the course you have in mind.

beginners.q: Is the course suitable for beginners?
beginners.a: Yes. Every technique is taught at base level, which starts from the beginning, and at advanced level for those already working.
